threads.title: [Reel] Why is the lock stricter than needed?
threads.question: Why is the lock stricter than needed?
threads.author: bob

replies.author: alice
replies.body:
Each cursor has a **single writer**, so ordering only needs `acquire`/`release`.

- See [the C++ memory model](https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/atomic/memory_order).
- Rewatch [the handoff](?scene=happens-before&t=3000).
